global_rules: Independent RGBA parts all derived from the SAME original shot mother; SHA verified.
Anatomical pivots measured in actual source pixels, never guessed in this editorial document.
Vertex mesh for hair, cloth, dress and cape where movement is required.
Underlay inpainted and verified opaque before moving a detached actor/prop.
FFmpeg and FFprobe are for decoded-frame/media QA only, never animation of flat PNG.
No full-PNG pan/zoom/bounce as replacement for articulated rig.
Visible surfaces, facial seams, masks and occlusion must pass human review.
Match cut uses two independent mothers; do not morph faces.
HUD/subtitles appear in Remotion layers; no baked-on PNG text.
Do not spend external provider funds or publish YouTube without explicit approval.
